Our Story

A family kitchen that grew into a trusted brand

Bhavnaben Bharatbhai Shah

Bhavnaben Khakhrawala began in 1998 in a home kitchen in Surat with one belief: honest ingredients make the best snacks. Today the family continues that craft from Amroli, Surat, offering khakhra, dry bhakhri and coin khakhra in dozens of flavours.

For 28 years the taste has stayed the same, and our quality now meets export standards, so customers abroad enjoy the same crunch as those next door.

Email: bhavnabenkhakhrawala1998@gmail.com

How we make it

Select

Wheat is chosen and ground into flour in-house.

Prepare

Flour is sieved and water filtered, then kneaded with spices and flavours.

Each piece is roasted till crisp, cooled and sealed in vacuum or container packs.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you may want to know before you order

What is khakhra?

Khakhra is a thin, crisp Gujarati flatbread made from whole wheat flour and roasted until crunchy. It is a light snack for breakfast, tea-time and travel.

Is your khakhra made the Jain way?

Yes. Our flour is sieved and our water is filtered before it touches the dough, and we prepare everything in a hygienic kitchen.

Which products and pack sizes do you offer?

Round Khakhra (200 g, 500 g), Dry Bhakhri (150 g, 200 g), Coin Khakhra (45 g, 200 g) and Handmade Khakhra (200 g, 500 g), in dozens of flavours.

How do I place an order?

Choose your products and flavours on the Order page, fill in your details and send the request. You instantly get an Order ID, and we contact you to confirm the details.

Do you deliver outside India?

Yes. Our quality meets export standards and the order form accepts addresses from other countries. Select your country while ordering and we will confirm shipping details with you.

Do you supply to shops, wholesalers and for bulk orders?

Yes. Use our Wholesale and Bulk page to send your requirement. We will get back to you with details for your business.

How should I store khakhra?

Keep it in a cool, dry place and close the pack or an airtight container after opening so it stays crisp.

How can I contact you?

Call or WhatsApp us on +91 99255 20051, or email bhavnabenkhakhrawala1998@gmail.com.

Privacy Policy

Last updated October 2026

Bhavnaben Khakhrawala (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect through this website and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Name, mobile number, email address and delivery address that you enter in our order form.
  • The product, flavour, pack size and quantity you choose.
  • Your country, city and postal code for international delivery.
  • Your name, city, rating and comment if you post a review (these appear publicly on this site), and your business details if you send a wholesale enquiry.

How we use it

  • To contact you about your order.
  • To deliver your products and improve our service.

Sharing and storage

We never sell your data. It is stored securely in our database and shared only with delivery partners when needed to complete your order.

Your choices

You can ask us to view, correct or delete your information at any time by calling us or using the contact page.
